title: 第26章 不落的太阳第25章 KING入局止战
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: （感谢持明哥的高考红包！！梅林老师已经金榜题名了今天就要去洗脚狠狠奖励自己捏！！！）
（感谢渡边桑制作的人设图！非常符合梅林老师心中的角色设定，比我自己用ai跑的好了一百倍！果然这种事还得术业有专攻。从今天会将新的人设图依次放出！）
这一刻，齐格飞的脑海里没来由地想到了罗德里克最擅长的那种奥菲斯棋戏——战棋。
在战棋的规则里，“国王”这枚棋子的性能是除了“步兵”以外最弱的。
论机动，不及“战车”纵横棋盘；论攻势，不及“火炮”隔阵轰杀；论锋利，不及“骑士”突入腹地，更不及“英雄”横扫八方。
它一步一步挪，像个累赘偏偏整盘棋的胜负，又全系于它一身。
所有强大的棋子，拼杀、换位、牺牲，归根结底都只为两件事：保护自己的王，并杀死对方的王。
然而“国王”虽然弱，却并不总是无用。在两种情况下，它甚至能爆发出远超其他所有棋子的力量。
其一，是残局。当双方底牌尽出，棋盘上再没有足够的屏障与杀器时，原本只能被人保护的“国王”，就会摇身一变为棋盘上最强大的棋子。
其二，便是当双方国王之间，没有任何棋子作为屏障时，那么能行动的那一方，便可以无视棋局上所有繁复变化，一步将死对手。
而这一手，俗称“刺王”。
哒。
皮靴停住，罗德里克抱着昏迷的克琳希德，就这么直挺挺地从下水道走出来，走进阳光之下。
一时间，齐格飞甚至连怒气都没能涌上来，只有大片难以言喻的荒唐感，缓缓灌满胸腔。
他……他又出卖我？
身处钟楼之上的拉斐尔率先反应过来。
六翼一振，神父打扮的智天使在半空划出一道弧线，顷刻赶到国王近前。
“陛下，您还好吗？可有受伤？”
话音刚落，他便看见了罗德里克脸上的淤青，以及嘴角尚未擦净的血污：
“在下这就为您疗伤！”
“用不着。”
罗德里克挥开拉斐尔伸来的手，沉声下令：
“你现在就传话加百列，叫祂即刻停火。”
拉斐尔一怔，便立刻应声，以“神之舌”向王都的加百列传去了犹大安好的消息。
顷刻之间，那回荡在全场众人耳畔的庄严宣告，以及铺天盖地向整座龙都压下来的天崩之感，骤然散去。
凝涩成固体的空气重新散开，鱼贯而入肺腔。
一时间，无论是散落在城市各处的几位【瓦尔基里】，还是横在麦克维斯身前的罗兰，乃至高空中遮挡阳光的法芙娜，都忍不住齐齐吐出一口劫后余生般的长气。
如人饮水，冷暖自知。齐格飞作为在场唯一的sss级，对刚才那股压迫感却感受得并不真切。
可对于其余超凡者而言，加百列这一箭若是真的落下，能不能扛下来，真就只是五五之数。
“咦？那不是殿下和二王子殿下吗？”
卡塔丽娜站在齐格飞身侧，望着钟楼方向，眼珠眨巴了两下，满脸震撼。
虽然这么说有点破坏气氛，但在浮游岛上与世隔绝了三年的卡塔丽娜，记忆还停留在罗德里克仍是摄政王子的时期。
无论莉莉丝还是胡德，都没有和这傻妞讲太多关于摩恩与齐格飞的事，以免她修业分心。
单刀直入地说，她甚至都不知道此行来摩恩具体是要做什么。
总之就是感受到了某种类似当年神降大战尼科勒提米斯的动静，于是便带着一票教官赶来打架了。
然而现在架还没开打，自家的两位殿下竟然就跑到了敌人那边。傻狍子的内心究竟有多震撼，可想而知。
齐格飞一言不发，只是死死盯着罗德里克的身影，拳头攥得咯咯作响。
content_en:
(Thanks to Brother Chi Ming for the college entrance examination red envelope!! Teacher Mei Lin has been named on the gold list and today I am going to wash my feet and reward myself!!!)
(Thanks to Watanabe-san for the character design! It is very consistent with the character design in Teacher Meilin's mind, and it is a hundred times better than what I can do with AI myself! As expected, this kind of thing requires specialization in the art. New character pictures will be released one after another from today!)
At this moment, Siegfried's mind suddenly thought of the Orpheus game Roderick was best at - war chess.
According to the rules of war chess, the performance of the "King" chess piece is the weakest except for the "Infantry".
In terms of maneuverability, it is not as good as a "chariot" to cross the chessboard; in terms of offensive power, it is not as good as a "artillery" to blast away from behind; in terms of sharpness, it is not as good as a "knight" to break into the hinterland, and not as good as a "hero" to sweep across all directions.
It moved step by step, like a burden, but the outcome of the entire chess game depended on it.
All powerful chess pieces fight, change positions, and sacrifice, in the final analysis, only for two things: to protect their own king, and to kill the opponent's king.
However, although the "King" is weak, it is not always useless. In both cases, it can even explode with power that far exceeds that of all other pieces.
One is the endgame. When both sides have exhausted their cards and there are no longer enough barriers and weapons on the chessboard, the "king" who could only be protected by others will suddenly become the most powerful piece on the chessboard.
The second is that when there are no chess pieces as a barrier between the two kings, the side that can move can ignore all the complicated changes in the chess game and checkmate the opponent in one move.
And this hand is commonly known as "The King of Assassins".
clatter.
The leather boots stopped, Roderick held the unconscious Clinhild, and walked straight out of the sewer into the sunshine.
For a moment, Siegfried didn't even feel angry, only a large, indescribable sense of absurdity slowly filled his chest.
He...he betrayed me again?
"Your Majesty!!"
Raphael, who was on top of the bell tower, was the first to react.
With a flutter of its six wings, the cherubim dressed as a priest drew an arc in the air and rushed to the king in an instant.
"Your Majesty, are you okay? Are you injured?"
As soon as he finished speaking, he saw the bruises on Rodrick's face and the blood on the corners of his mouth that had not yet been wiped off:
"I'll heal your injuries right here!"
"No need."
Roderick waved away Raphael's extended hand and ordered in a deep voice:
"Send a message to Gabriel now and tell him to cease fire immediately."
Raphael was startled, and immediately responded, using the "Tongue of God" to convey the news of Judah's well-being to Gabriel in the royal capital.
In an instant, the solemn declaration that echoed in the ears of everyone in the audience, and the overwhelming feeling of collapse that was pressing down on the entire dragon, suddenly dissipated.
The solid air dispersed again and entered the lungs.
For a time, both the several [Valkyries] scattered throughout the city, Roland lying in front of McVis, and even Fafna, who was blocking the sun in the sky, couldn't help but let out a long sigh of relief.
Just like a person drinking water, he knows whether it is warm or cold. Siegfried, as the only SSS-level person present, did not really feel the pressure just now.
But for the other extraordinary beings, if Gabriel's arrow really falls, it's only a matter of 50 or 50 whether they can hold it down.
"Eh? Aren't those His Highness and His Highness the Second Prince?"
Katarina stood beside Siegfried, looking in the direction of the clock tower, blinking twice, her face full of shock.
Although saying this kind of ruins the atmosphere, Catalina, who has been isolated on the floating island for three years, still has memories of the time when Roderick was still the prince regent.
Neither Lilith nor Hood told this silly girl too much about Morn and Siegfried, so as not to distract her from her studies.
To put it bluntly, she didn’t even know what she was going to do on her trip to Moen.
In short, I felt something similar to the movement of God descending to fight Nicoretimis, so I came with a group of instructors to fight.
However, before the fight started, the two royal highnesses actually ran to the enemy's side. One can imagine how shocked Silly Roe Deer was.
Siegfried said nothing, just stared at Roderick's figure, clenching his fists.
